text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅14日应约同法国外长巴罗通电话。 王毅表示，在两国元首战略引领下，中法关系总体保持稳定发展势头。当前国际形势变乱交织，中法作为安理会常任理事国，应当加强战略沟通，共同应对风险挑战。中方积极支持法国履职本月安理会轮值主席国，期待法方推动安理会发挥应有作用。
text_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, had a phone call with French Foreign Minister Barrot on the 14th at the latter's request. Wang Yi said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, China-France relations have generally maintained a momentum of stable development. Amid the current intertwined changes and turmoil in the international situation, China and France, as permanent members of the UN Security Council, should strengthen strategic communication and jointly respond to risks and challenges. China actively supports France in performing its duties as this month's rotating president of the UN Security Council and looks forward to France promoting the Security Council in playing its due role.
